items.name: Plurai Simulation
items.tagline: A simulated world that makes your agent improve on every run
items.description: Find your agent’s worst bugs before your users do. One command in Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot builds a digital twin of your agent’s world: synthetic personas and documents, plus mocked tools, APIs and databases, in sandboxes that never touch production.

items.name: YouArt Desktop App
items.tagline: Codex for creative team
items.description: Meet YouArt Desktop App: AI creative teammate that lives on your computer. Agent-first video production is here. Pull your local files and context from Slack, Gmail and GitHub onto one canvas, and with computer use it operates After Effects, CapCut and Blender directly. From feature launch videos to viral remakes and clips from your long videos, it takes the whole job end to end. Bring your own API keys, and smart routing sends every shot to the cheapest provider.

items.name: Omnigraph
items.tagline: Open source graph database for your AI agents
items.description: Omnigraph is an open-source object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology. It allows AI agents safely collaborate on shared knowledge. Give agents one typed graph with Git-like branching, review, and merge for every write, so changes can be validated before becoming shared context. Run it on your own S3-compatible storage, with semantic, keyword, and hybrid search plus graph traversal in one query. No hosted memory API or proprietary storage required.

items.name: ⌘+L
items.tagline: Edit your website like Figma!
items.description: Command L (⌘+L) is a magical script tag so you can edit your website like a Figma file. In the background, Claude Code, Codex, or Letterpress-1 will automatically turn the change into the perfect pull request.

items.name: Adobe AI Assistant
items.tagline: Create and edit faster with AI across Adobe apps
items.description: Adobe AI Assistant brings conversational AI into Creative Cloud. Describe what you want to accomplish, and let it handle multi-step creative tasks across Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, and Firefly.

items.name: Spacefast by Automattic
items.tagline: Give your AI agents a place to build, run, and ship
items.description: Spacefast is a new way to ship websites and apps with the AI you already use. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or your favorite agent, and publish your project with a simple request. Spacefast handles hosting, databases, domains, file uploads, and version history. Share private links, collect feedback directly on your pages, and let your agent make updates. Built by Automattic, the company behind WordPress.com. Free to start, with no extra AI subscription.

items.name: Harness Memory
items.tagline: Long-term memory for agents, across every harness
items.description: Harness Memory gives every harness agent its own long-term memory. Pick a memory engine (Mem0, Graphiti, Hindsight, ReMe, or your own) and plug it into different agent harnesses, like Claude Code, Codex and Hermes. Memory can be shared across agent harnesses, with fine-grained access control. Open source in Community Edition and available on HarnessRouter Cloud.

items.name: Nameshot
items.tagline: Your screenshots named automatically
items.description: A tiny app that solves a big problem: naming your messy stash of "Screenshot 2025-12-15 at 06.59.24" nonsense entirely on device via Apple Intelligence.

items.name: Grok Bot 1.0
items.tagline: Bots work together alongside your team
items.description: Bots now work with your whole team, take on work without being asked, and get more done, faster.

items.name: three.dev
items.tagline: Find out how your AI agent fails. Before your users do.
items.description: Almost every team now runs AI in production, but few know how it behaves once real users show up. The failures are quiet: a wrong refund policy, a made-up order status. Nothing crashes, so you hear about it from your users. three.dev finds those failures in your live traffic on its own and ranks them by severity. Setup is one prompt to Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Then your coding agent gets what it needs to write the fix.

items.name: Gemini Decisions API
items.tagline: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
items.description: Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.

items.name: Toki Matter
items.tagline: The Al agent that advances your matters
items.description: Personal agents can take work off your plate. Toki makes sure you never lose track of it. See everything Toki is handling, follow each goal’s progress in real time, step in when a decision needs you, then hand it back. Instead of managing the agent itself, you stay focused on the bigger picture while Toki keeps the work moving.

items.name: Hoy for Mac
items.tagline: Walkie-talkie meets AirDrop meets Messages
items.description: Hoy puts your people in your Mac's menu bar, on top of everything you do. Drop a file on a face. Hold to talk, and Hoy writes it down as you speak. Show your screen. Hand over a to-do. Every face is a channel, with one person or a group, and a link is all it takes to bring someone in. No sign-up, no middleman: your channels live in your own iCloud and there is no Hoy server. Free, with a pay-once Pro. Needs macOS 26. iPhone and iPad are coming soon.

items.name: Neura HQ
items.tagline: The agentic conversational storefront for consumer brands
items.description: In B2C, every touchpoint is a stay-or-leave decision. Customers find you through ads, social, or stores, and leave the moment they don’t get what they want. Neura is the agentic conversational storefront that meets them in that moment, wherever they are. It recommends, shares offers, checks online and in-store stock, points them to the nearest store, tracks orders and stays with them through the whole journey, like your best person on the floor. Set it up in minutes, just by talking to it.

items.name: Sendr V4: Lovable for GTM
items.tagline: Your AI GTM engineer to build signal based go-to-market
items.description: Sendr V4 is Lovable for GTM. Describe your funnel and Co-pilot, your trained GTM engineer, builds your go to market flow on an editable canvas in under 5 minutes, in your brand and tone of voice. Spin up outreach campaigns that engage, or build connection with inbounds, website visitors, CRM, LinkedIn ad engagers and from market signals. Then connect from signals with every contact on email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp with personalised voice notes and videos that play in DMs.

items.name: Yogurt
items.tagline: Free, private, open-source alternative to Granola
items.description: Yogurt takes AI meeting notes without joining your call as a bot. It records Zoom, Google Meet and Teams in the background, shows a live transcript, and writes a summary with next steps when the call ends. Ask questions across all your meetings, a folder or one call, even mid-meeting. Replay the full audio, share notes with Claude or ChatGPT via MCP, and recordings stop when the call does. Free, open source, no account. Everything stays on your computer. Works on Mac/Windows/Linux.

items.name: Didit MCP
items.tagline: The MCP server for identity verification and fraud checks
items.description: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, VS Code or Codex to Didit. Ask in plain English: your agent builds KYC and KYB flows, checks IDs against government databases, screens people and wallets for AML and back-tests fraud rules.

items.name: CanyonOS
items.tagline: The One Platform for Scaling your Agentic Apps
items.description: CanyonOS is a workflow-aware platform to build, scale, observe and manage agentic applications. It carries every call between your agents, so it can automatically find and scale just the ones holding up your workflow and show how much each agent adds to your costs, with no tracing code to write. Your agents stay plain Python. Open source under AGPL-3.0.

items.name: Cloudways Velocity
items.tagline: Managed Node.js hosting. Always warm, never off.
items.description: Deploy production-ready Node.js apps in minutes. Managed infrastructure, enterprise-grade security, and flat, predictable pricing, so there are no cold starts to worry about, and no billing surprises.

items.name: Customer.io Fall Release
items.tagline: Smarter marketing through Agent-recommended experiments
items.description: Customer.io’s Fall Release brings Agent-recommended experiments to your marketing. Ask your Agent what to test next and get specific experiment ideas for your automations. Design Studio is now the default editor, with agentic drafting built in.
